title: Mexican Poke Salad
description: A fresh and light Mexican-inspired poke salad with cherry tomatoes, quenching flavor, and a touch of Brazilian spice.

ingredients.name: Light Poke Marinade
ingredients.notes: Combine 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon lime juice, 1 minced garlic clove, and 1 teaspoon diced cilantro.

ingredients.name: Brazilian-Style Roasted Peppers
ingredients.notes: Roast 2 red bell peppers at 400°F for 30 minutes, then peel and slice.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Light Poke Marinade ingredients.
Add the Quenching Cherry Tomatoes, Brazilian-Style Roasted Peppers, and Fresh Cilantro to the marinade.
Toss to coat and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, squeeze the Lime Juice over the salad and season with Salt and Pepper to taste.
Garnish with Crushed Tortilla Chips, if using.
